exposure: Delivery mode (vaginal delivery [V] or cesarean section [C])
finding: Cesarean section was associated with higher abundance of the phylum Firmicutes and family Enterococcaceae, and intense fluctuation of SCFA, at least propionate, while breastfeeding might partially contribute to gut microbiota construction and stabilization of propionate metabolism in cesarean-section infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with higher abundance of the phylum Firmicutes and family Enterococcaceae, and intense fluctuation of SCFA, at least propionate.
